caption: The drawing features three main symmetrical decorative motifs with an additional curved design at the bottom. At the lower center, there is a large, circular flower-like motif composed of alternating red and blue petal shapes outlined in red, with yellow crescent shapes near the center, and a segmented yellow-and-red inner ring with a small blue circle crossed by a red X at the core. Above and to the left, there is a star-shaped motif with eight yellow, petal-like arms outlined in red and alternating blue and yellow inner details. Its center has blue circles surrounded by a yellow-and-red ring with a vertical oval in the very middle. Above and to the right, another eight-pointed star-shaped motif appears, this time alternating broad blue and narrow yellow triangles outlined in red, with a circular yellow-and-red center and small blue arrow-like shapes at each point. At the bottom of the page, below the central motif, two large, curved lines in blue and red form a symmetrical, wave-like design. The background of the drawing is tan or beige, and small dots of color are used for accenting some motifs.
title: San Juan Capistrano Mission Ceiling Decoration From the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
